name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 18 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 18 hours starting 2026-03-02, at wavelengths from 0.77 to 4.21 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
